prompt: RimWorld top-down plant sprite, painterly vanilla-RimWorld plant art style: a single clump of quickgrass burned down to scorched stubble after a grass fire. Heavy, clean black outline around the whole silhouette and all major internal linework, thick enough to read clearly at standard RimWorld zoom and below.
